setup: s.level = Math.max(8, s.level); window.__ship = await import('/ship.mjs'); window.__t0 = s.time; return true;
until: (() => { const q = s.people.filter(p => p.status === 'queue'); if (q.length > 3) { s.selected = q[0].id; s.assign(Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)); } const S = s.ship; if (s.time - window.__t0 > 40 && S.phase === 'calm' && !window.__rogue) window.__rogue = window.__ship.rogueSwell(s); return window.__rogue && S.phase === 'hold' && S.t > 0.6; })()
after: const S = s.ship; return { focus: [0, 0, 0], angle: S.angle * 57.3, phase: S.phase, people: s.people.length, st: s.people.map(p => p.status).join(','), adrift: s.roof?.beds.filter(b => b.adrift).length };
